events.name: Bash
events.head: Read both export scripts' library gates, the generator, stale references, the rule and publish log
events.input: $ echo "--- export-centre"; sed -n 55,80p cloud/.export-centre.sh; echo "--- export-static"; sed -n 58,78p app/scripts/export-static.sh; echo "--- build.sh"; grep -n -i "T-141\|if false\|PUBLISH_VERBATIM\|examples" cloud/scripts/build.sh | head -30; echo "--- stale refs"; grep -rn "T-141 (P0\|held for T-141\|PUBLISH_VERBATIM" app/scripts cloud --include=*.sh --include=*.mjs --include=*.md --include=*.js -s | grep -v node_modules | head -20; echo "--- LANES"; grep -n -i "T-141" workshop-plan/coord/LANES.md | head -8; echo "--- LOG"; grep -n "08:15\|e4f856b" workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the centre build generator head and list remotes and probes
events.input: $ sed -n 1,40p cloud/scripts/build.sh | cut -c1-260; echo "--- remotes"; git remote -v | head; git -C live remote -v 2>/dev/null | head -2; git -C live log --oneline -2 2>/dev/null; ls app/scripts | grep -i "probe-anon\|probe-fid\|check-guides\|probe-library"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the anonymity, fidelity and guide checks
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && (node scripts/probe-anonymity.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4); echo "--- fidelity"; (node scripts/probe-fidelity.mjs 2>&1 | tail -5); echo "--- guides"; (node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8)

events.name: Bash
events.head: Ask the GitHub API whether the old leak commit is still reachable on the public mirror
events.input: $ cd /tmp && for sha in 5b9f57d6; do echo "commit $sha: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://api.github.com/repos/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live/commits/$sha)"; done; curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('forks',d.get('forks_count'),'private',d.get('private'),'default',d.get('default_branch'))"; curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live/branches | python3 -c "
